tooltip.aethercore.desc1: An ancient guardian. When fueled it raises a 16-block hexagonal shield.
tooltip.aethercore.desc2: Repels hostiles, blocks projectiles, stops monster spawns, heals players.
tooltip.aethercore.desc3: Fuel: Amethyst Shard, Diamond, Echo Shard, Nether Star
message.aethercore.empty: The core has no energy. Feed it amethyst, diamond, echo shard or nether star.
